title: Siege of Batavia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Batavia", at revision 1373913583, opens: "The siege of Batavia was a military campaign led by Sultan Agung of Mataram to capture the Dutch port-settlement of Batavia in western Java. The first attempt was launched in 1628, and the second in 1629; both were unsuccessful." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7509865, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military campaign in Java by Sultan Agung in 1628 and 1629". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
